school.elementalarcana.fire.desc: Raw, burning power. Strikes hard and leaves enemies ablaze.
school.elementalarcana.water.desc: Flowing and restorative. Pushes foes away and mends allies.
school.elementalarcana.ice.desc: Cold and precise. Slows, freezes and controls the battlefield.
school.elementalarcana.wind.desc: Swift and free. Rides the air and scatters anything close.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.desc: Hold to grow a fireball in your palm, release to throw it. It explodes where it lands, igniting everything nearby. Melts frozen enemies and Vaporizes wet ones for extra damage.
spell.elementalarcana.flame_burst.desc: Three wheels of flame orbit you for 8 seconds, burning and throwing back whatever they sweep through. Keep fighting while they spin.
spell.elementalarcana.ember_sprite.desc: Places a little fire spirit where you look. For 8 seconds it spits fire bolts at the nearest hostile creature, then pops.
spell.elementalarcana.tidal_wave.desc: A wall of water rolls away from you, sweeping up your enemies and putting out fires.
spell.elementalarcana.healing_rain.desc: A soothing shower that regenerates you and nearby players.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.desc: Hold to form an icicle that grows sharper, release to launch it. Full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.frost_nova.desc: Flash-freezes everything around you in place.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.desc: A burst of wind throws you the way you look, shoving foes away; your landing is safe. It holds more dashes as it grows.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.1.d: Dash the way you look, shoving away foes near where you started. Your landing never hurts.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.2.d: Hold two dashes; each comes back a cooldown after the last.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.3.d: In the air, dash any way you look, even down, and nothing can hurt you while you dash.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.4.d: Your dash shoves foes aside and quickens the players you pass.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.5.d: Choose a path: Phantom Step or Gale Strike.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.6.d: A burst of speed after each dash, and a quarter off its cooldown.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.8.d: After a dash in the air you drift down slowly, so you can chain dashes.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.tier.9.d: Dashing through a foe that carries an element Swirls it.
Choose a path: Blink Storm or Hurricane Rush.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.branch.p: For a second after a dash you're unseen: whatever was hunting you loses you.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.branch.g: Dashing through foes hurts them and throws them Airborne.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.branch.b: The dash becomes a blink of up to 8 blocks, with a gust at either end that hurts and throws back foes.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.branch.h: Hold cast to keep rushing the way you look for up to 2 seconds, hitting everything you pass.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.desc: A gust throws you skyward and foes around you away. Then hold jump while you fall to glide.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.1.des: Leap about 9 blocks up, throwing foes within 4 blocks away and up (Airborne). For 8 seconds you're Skyward: hold jump while falling to glide. Your first landing never hurts.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.2.des: Leap about 13 blocks, stay Skyward for 12 seconds, and sink slower as you glide.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.3.des: Press cast again while gliding to catch an updraft, once a leap. It's free, even while the spell recharges.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.4.des: Sneak while Skyward in the air to dive. You land in a shockwave that grows with the height you fell.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.5.des: Choose a path: Skyfall or Wind Rider.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.6.des: The leap's gust reaches 6 blocks and throws foes higher.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.7.des: You glide faster, and no landing hurts while you're Skyward.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.8.des: Wind spells cost 30% less mana while you're Skyward and in the air.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.9.des: The plunge's shockwave Swirls the elements of whatever it hits.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.tier.10.de: Choose a path: Heaven's Descent or Endless Sky.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.branch.sky: The plunge's shockwave is half again as wide and hits half again as hard, and throws what it hits Airborne.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.branch.win: The first 6 seconds of Skyward are free flight: jump to rise, sneak to sink. Then you glide.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.branch.hea: The plunge's shockwave is twice as wide and leaves a whirlwind where you land, pulling foes in.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.branch.end: Skyward lasts until you land, and every Wind Blade you throw while gliding lifts you a little.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.desc: A tornado rises where you look, dragging in foes, lifting them and spinning them round.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.1.de: A tornado rises on the ground where you look (up to 20 blocks away) for 4 seconds: foes within 5 blocks are dragged in, lifted (Airborne) and spun round, and hurt every half second.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.2.de: It pulls harder and lasts 5 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.3.de: The first burning, frozen or wet foe it takes gives it that element: it changes colour, and everything it holds catches it.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.5.de: Choose a path: Wandering Storm or Twin Storms.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.6.de: It hits half again as hard, and when it ends it flings what it held outward.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.7.de: Every second it Swirls what it holds, spreading their elements to whatever is near them.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.8.de: It lasts 7 seconds and sends dropped items and experience to you.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.9.de: Airborne foes it holds take double damage from everything.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.tier.10.d: Choose a path: Great Tempest or Eye of Calm.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.branch.wa: The tornado drifts toward where you look for as long as it lasts.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.branch.tw: Two smaller tornadoes rise and circle each other.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.branch.gr: The tornado is twice as big and reaches twice as far, and projectiles that fly into it are thrown back out.
spell.elementalarcana.stormeye.branch.ey: The storm rises around you and moves with you: foes are held at its wall, projectiles aimed at you are thrown aside, and you and players inside mend a heart every 2 seconds.

spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.1.desc: Hold to form an icicle, release to launch it. A full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.2.desc: Two icicles form, one over each shoulder, and fly together.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.3.desc: Icicles charge in 0.75s, and even a quick tap-throw hits harder.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.4.desc: Three icicles form a crescent above you.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.5.desc: Choose a path: Piercing Cold or Shatterburst.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.6.desc: +25% damage, and full-charge freezes last longer.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.7.desc: Icicles curve toward the enemy nearest your crosshair.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.8.desc: Up to five icicles form an arc over your head.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.9.desc: Three hits from one volley freeze an enemy solid for 2 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.10.des: Choose a path: Glacial Lance or Endless Winter.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.pier: Icicles pass through up to 2 enemies and fly 30% faster.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.shat: Icicles shatter on impact into a spray of shrapnel: eight shards that fly on past what they hit, each cutting whatever it strikes for 30% damage.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.lanc: Keep holding after full charge: your icicles fuse into one giant lance that pierces everything. Where it lands, ice spikes erupt, striking everything within 3.5 blocks for half damage and throwing it up.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.wint: Kills refund half the cooldown. Full-charge hits leave frost patches that slow enemies.

spell.elementalarcana.frost_shield.desc: A shell of ice shards orbits you and absorbs damage, then shatters outward when it breaks.
Absorbs 6 damage for 8s. When it breaks it shatters, slowing enemies nearby.
Anything that strikes your shield in melee is slowed and frosted over.
Raise the shield just before a hit lands: a perfect block that throws back and freezes the attacker.
Choose a path: Mirror Frost or Frost Mantle.
Allies within 5 blocks also get a shield at half strength.
When your shield breaks, its shards explode and cut everything within 4 blocks.
The shield slowly regrows while up, and you're immune to fire and freezing.
An enemy that hits your shield three times is frozen solid.
Choose a path: Absolute Zero or Frozen Sanctuary.
spell.elementalarcana.frost_shield.branc: Arrows and other projectiles bounce off your shield, back at whoever fired them.
A thinner shield, but while it's up you gain armor, can't be knocked back, and your melee hits chill enemies.
Your shield becomes a dome: no projectile gets through, and enemies pushing in are thrown back and slowed.
A killing blow while shielded encases you in ice instead: invulnerable for 3s while you heal. Once every 5 minutes.
message.elementalarcana.frost_shield.san: Frozen Sanctuary: the ice saved you!
spell.elementalarcana.wind_blade.desc: Hold to gather a crescent of wind, release to slash toward your target. Wind hits Swirl other elements.
Hold to form a crescent of wind, release to throw it. Knockback grows with the charge.
Two crescents, fanned into a V.
Blades cut through one enemy, charge in 0.75s, and even quick taps hit harder.
Choose a path: Boomerang or Tempest Edge.
+25% damage, and a full charge launches targets Airborne (they take 25% more damage until they land).
Releasing your blades gives you a burst of speed.
Five crescents in a wide fan.
Blades deal double damage to Airborne enemies.
spell.elementalarcana.wind_blade.tier.10: Choose a path: Storm Scythe or Thousand Cuts.
Blades fly out, then turn and come back to you, cutting enemies again on the way.
Fully charged blades leave a small whirlwind where they land, pulling enemies together.
Keep holding after full charge: your blades merge into one giant crescent that cuts through everything in its path.
Every blade that hits splits into two smaller blades that seek out the nearest other enemies.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.1.de: Hold to grow a fireball, release to throw it. It bursts in a small explosion that sets things alight.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.2.de: The explosion grows to 2.5 blocks and burns longer.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.3.de: Fireballs charge in 0.75s, and even a quick tap-throw becomes a fast bolt that hits hard.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.4.de: Two fireballs, one over each hand.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.5.de: Choose a path: Cluster Bomb or Meteor.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.6.de: +25% damage, and burning enemies take a further +25%.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.7.de: Enemies that die while burning explode, setting everything around them alight. It can chain.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.8.de: A third fireball floats above your hands.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.9.de: Explosions leave burning ground for 3 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.tier.10.d: Choose a path: Sunfire or Phoenix.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.cl: The fireball bursts into 4 bouncing bomblets that go off one after another.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.me: Fireballs are lobbed in a high arc and land in a huge explosion with strong knockback, leaving burning ground.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.su: Keep holding after full charge: your fireballs fuse into a miniature sun that detonates in a blinding blast.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.branch.ph: Fireballs home in on the enemy nearest your crosshair and fly through it. A phoenix that kills flies on to one more target.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.desc: Hold to spray a pressurized stream of water: rapid hits that push enemies back and soak them. Puts out fires; soaked enemies Freeze under ice and Vaporize under fire.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.1.d: Hold to spray a 12-block stream for up to 2 seconds. It pushes enemies back and makes them Wet.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.2.d: The stream lasts 3 seconds and reaches 16 blocks.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.3.d: Where the stream lands, the spray hits and soaks everything within 1.5 blocks.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.4.d: An enemy soaked for a full second is marked. Your next hit on it bursts for bonus damage.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.5.d: Choose a path: Tidecutter or Torrent.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.6.d: +10% damage for every half second you keep spraying, up to +50%.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.7.d: The stream heals players it touches instead of hurting them.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.8.d: Aim down to ride your jet into the air. While spraying, you drift down gently.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.tier.9.d: Wet lasts 10 seconds, and the stream slows what it hits.
Choose a path: Maelstrom or Tsunami Lance.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.t: A thin cutting line: it passes through every enemy in its path for 60% more damage, without pushing them.
A wide fire-hose blast that shoves whole crowds back hard and turns lava into obsidian.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.m: Spray for 2 seconds or more and, when you let go, the spot you hit becomes a whirlpool that drags enemies around for 4 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.hydro_jet.branch.l: When you let go, the stream compresses into a giant water spear that pierces everything. The longer you sprayed, the stronger it is.

stat.elementalarcana.potency.desc: Raises the power of every spell: damage, knockback and durations.
stat.elementalarcana.ward.desc: Softens elemental damage: spells and creature magic.
stat.elementalarcana.insight.desc: Hits that set off a reaction (Melt, Vaporize, Freeze, Swirl) hit harder, and Essence drops more often.
stat.elementalarcana.affinity.desc: Raises the power of %s spells, and of every element in its family.
jei.elementalarcana.info.essence: Elemental Essence, the stuff of magic. Attuned creatures drop it (Adepts half the time, Magi and Archmages always), and so do wisps (the main source for Crystal, Lightning and Radiance) and, now and then, creatures born with an element. Shrines, mage towers and sanctums hold some, and Arcanists buy and sell it. Infuse it into a spell to master it (the skill tree's bottom panel), Condense it into tree points (the Status screen), spend it to take back a node, and craft gear, Catalysts and the Arcane Lectern with it.
jei.elementalarcana.info.catalyst: Right-click it to try to wake its element in you; it's used up every try. The odds grow with your level and with each failed try: a second element is realistic after level 10, a third from 20, a fourth from 30. Opposed elements (Fire and Radiance against Water and Ice) can't be held together until level 50. Arcanists sell Catalysts, and shrine chests sometimes hold one.
jei.elementalarcana.info.wisp_mote: Wisps drop it. Brewed into an Awkward Potion it makes an Elixir of Clarity: your mana regenerates twice as fast for 3 minutes.
jei.elementalarcana.info.guardian_core: Left by a mage tower's Magister when it falls. The towers are rare (about one every 900 blocks, never near the world's centre), and the Magister appears in the sanctum at the top. The key to master gear: the Master Staff and the master robes. A Crystal, Lightning or Radiance staff takes its kin's Core.
jei.elementalarcana.info.sovereign_heart: Left by a Sovereign when it falls in its sanctum, far out in the world: Vulkhar of Flame, Thalassa of Tides, Caelum of Storms or Orvald of Stone. Master Arcanists sell Sanctum Maps. The key to archmage gear; the four together make the Prime Key.
jei.elementalarcana.info.prime_key: Hold it (like eating) for two seconds in the Overworld: the way opens, and you and everyone within 6 blocks are taken to the Hollow. The key is spent.
jei.elementalarcana.info.prime_heart: Everyone who binds the Hollow gets one. Use it: every element you don't hold yet awakens, opposites included, and you gain 5 tree points.
jei.elementalarcana.info.arcane_lectern: The Arcanist's workstation: an unemployed villager near one takes the job. Arcanists buy Essence and amethyst, and sell the Journal, wands and staves, robes, Essence, Catalysts, brews, and two rarities: the Scroll of Unbinding and the Tome of Insight.
jei.elementalarcana.info.scroll_of_unbin: Only Expert Arcanists sell it. Use it to give back every skill tree node you bought, for free.
jei.elementalarcana.info.tome_of_insight: Only Master Arcanists sell it. Use it for one bonus tree point.
jei.elementalarcana.info.arcanist_journa: Given the first time your magic wakes: how magic works, a chapter for each element you hold, and the old story of the Prime and the Hollow. Lost it? Craft another from a book and any Essence.

school.elementalarcana.earth.desc: Heavy and steadfast. Holds ground, shrugs off blows and crushes what stands against it.
The stone did not crush you: your magic woke in answer.

school.elementalarcana.crystal.desc: Earth made keen. Sharp, precise, and hard to break.
school.elementalarcana.lightning.desc: Wind's fury. Leaps from foe to foe, and runs wild through anything wet.
school.elementalarcana.radiance.desc: Fire's pure light. Falls from the sky and burns the undead most of all.
The lightning did not burn you out: your magic woke in answer.

spell.elementalarcana.boulder.desc: Conjure a heavy boulder, then throw it. It arcs, crushes and shoves far.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.1.des: Press to conjure a boulder, click to throw it. It arcs, knocks back and cracks on impact.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.2.des: More damage, and it bounces once.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.3.des: Boulders conjure faster, and a quick tap-throw hits harder.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.4.des: Two boulders orbit you and fly together.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.5.des: Choose a path: Landslide or Bedrock.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.6.des: +25% damage, and Crystallize shards last longer.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.7.des: After landing, it rolls on along the ground, crushing what is in the way.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.8.des: Up to three boulders orbit you.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.9.des: Two hits from one volley stun a creature for 1.5 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.tier.10.de: Choose a path: Mountainfall or Avalanche.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.branch.lan: Each boulder shatters on impact into five rocks that spread out and keep hitting.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.branch.bed: Slower and bigger: +60% damage, a huge shove and a 1 second stun.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.branch.mou: Keep holding with a full set: your boulders fuse into one huge boulder that is lobbed onto the target area.
spell.elementalarcana.boulder.branch.ava: Where a boulder lands, rocks rain down on the area for 5 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.stone_skin.desc: Stones orbit you and soak up damage, then fly outward when they break.
Absorbs 8 damage for 10s. When it breaks, the fragments shove nearby enemies back.
Anything that hits you in melee is hurt in return.
Raise it just before a hit lands: a perfect block with no knockback that returns the damage.
Choose a path: Bastion or Crystal Carapace.
Allies within 5 blocks also get a shield at half strength.
When your shield breaks, its fragments cut everything within 4 blocks.
The shield slowly regrows, and you take no fall or suffocation damage.
An enemy that hits your shield three times is rooted for 2 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.stone_skin.tier.10: Choose a path: Fortress or Titan.
A thinner shield, but while it is up you gain armor and cannot be knocked back.
Crystallize shards you pick up add to your shield, and your thorns Crystallize attackers.
Your shield becomes a dome: no projectile gets through, and enemies pushing in are thrown back.
For 15 seconds you gain 4 hearts, +50% melee damage and no knockback.
spell.elementalarcana.tremor.desc: A shockwave rolls along the ground, throwing enemies up and slowing them.
spell.elementalarcana.prism_bolt.desc: A bolt of violet crystal. Whatever it hits, it bursts into three shards that fly on.
A fast bolt of crystal. Whatever it strikes, it bursts into three shards that fly on; off a wall they fly back out. It Crystallizes a burning, wet or frozen foe.
The bolt and its shards hit a fifth harder.
The bolt bursts through the first foe it strikes and flies on, bursting again on what it hits next.
Choose a path: Prismatic Lance or Geode Burst.
Every bolt that strikes a foe hardens a heart of crystal on you, up to four, for 15 seconds.
Each cast throws two bolts side by side.
A shard that strikes the foe its bolt just struck hits half again as hard.
Shards split once more when they strike a foe.
spell.elementalarcana.prism_bolt.tier.10: Choose a path: Crystal Spire or Prism Barrage.
The bolt flies half again as fast and pierces everything in its way, bursting only where it stops.
The bolt stops at the first thing it strikes, but bursts into ten shards all around that hit half again as hard.
Where a bolt first strikes, a spire of crystal grows for 6 seconds, throwing a shard at the nearest foe within 10 blocks every half second.
Hold cast to keep firing: a lighter bolt every 0.3 seconds for up to 2 seconds, for 6 mana each.
spell.elementalarcana.chain_lightning.de: Lightning leaps to the creature under your crosshair, then on from foe to foe. Wet foes carry it further.
spell.elementalarcana.chain_lightning.ti: Chain Lightning
Lightning leaps to the creature under your crosshair, then up to 3 jumps on to foes within 6 blocks, each a fifth weaker. Wet foes take half again as much and carry it 2 jumps further.
Long Arc
It jumps up to 8 blocks, and the first strike reaches 26.
Static
Every strike jolts: the foe is stunned for half a second.
Forked Chain
One more jump, and each jump loses only a tenth.
Crossroads
Choose a path: Storm Fork or Overload.
Conductor
Wet foes take double and carry it 3 jumps further. Rain counts as wet.
Thunderstruck
A bolt from the sky falls on your first target as well: that strike hits half again as hard.
Live Wire
One more jump. Struck foes stay charged for 3 seconds, and every second each arcs to the nearest other within 4 blocks.
Supercharge
No falloff: every jump strikes as hard as the first.
Capstone
Choose a path: Ball Lightning or Thunder Lord.
spell.elementalarcana.chain_lightning.br: Every strike forks to the two nearest foes, so the lightning spreads like a web (up to 10 strikes).
Only 2 jumps, but every strike bursts, hitting everything near the foe for half as much.
Each cast also looses a crackling orb that drifts the way you look for 4 seconds, striking short chains at foes near it.
Hold cast and the lightning keeps striking whatever you aim at, every half second for up to 3 seconds, for 6 mana a strike.
spell.elementalarcana.smite.desc: Marks the ground where you look. A moment later a pillar of light strikes it, burning all there. The undead suffer most.
No creature under your crosshair to strike
message.elementalarcana.tsunami.no_room: No room for a wave to rise
message.elementalarcana.tremor.no_ground: No ground under you for a Tremor to run along
message.elementalarcana.rift.opened: The air tears open nearby: a %s Rift!
commands.elementalarcana.rift_no_spot: Nowhere near here for a rift to open
message.elementalarcana.stormeye.no_grou: No ground there for a storm
spell.elementalarcana.prism_ward.desc: Crystal facets circle you for 6 seconds and turn every arrow, fireball and spell aimed at you back at whoever sent it.
spell.elementalarcana.thunderclap.desc: A thunderclap around you: everything within 5 blocks is struck, thrown back and stunned. Wet foes take more and stay stunned longer.
spell.elementalarcana.sanctuary.desc: A circle of light at your feet for 8 seconds: it mends you and your allies inside, and sears the undead.
journal.elementalarcana.page.1:
§5§lArcanist's Journal§r

§oNotes for the newly awakened.§r

Your magic has woken. These pages will help you find your way, and remember what was nearly forgotten.
journal.elementalarcana.page.2:
§5§lWhat happened§r

Every living thing holds a little mana. Few ever learn to use it. Yours woke, and an element answered.

It chose you, not the other way round.
journal.elementalarcana.page.3:
§5§lCasting§r

Your Status window shows your level, stats and spells (K). Hold the spell wheel (V), point at a spell and let go. Cast with R.

Some spells you hold; some you conjure one by one, then throw with a click.
journal.elementalarcana.page.4:
§5§lMana§r

Casting spends mana, which slowly refills. Sneak and stand still to meditate: it refills three times as fast. A night's sleep fills it.

Cast with too little, and your health pays the rest.
journal.elementalarcana.page.5:
§5§lGrowing§r

When something falls to you, you absorb its mana. Stronger foes give more; much weaker ones, nothing.

Each level brings a stat point and a tree point.
journal.elementalarcana.page.6:
§5§lStats§r

Reservoir: mana.
Potency: spell power.
Affinity: one element.
Focus: cooldowns.
Ward: elemental harm.
Vitality: health.
Insight: reactions.

Raise them from the Stats window.
journal.elementalarcana.page.7:
§5§lThe skill tree§r

Take nodes beside ones you hold. Small nodes raise stats, spell nodes teach spells, and a spell's chain raises its level, once its mastery bar is full (cast it to fill it).
journal.elementalarcana.page.8:
§5§lElements§r

Water quenches Fire.
Fire melts Ice.
Ice freezes Water.
Earth grounds Wind.
Water wears down Earth.

Every element shrugs off its own kind. Watch how your hits land to learn a creature's element.
journal.elementalarcana.page.9:
§5§lReactions§r

Melt: fire on ice.
Vaporize: water and fire.
Freeze: ice and water.
Swirl: wind spreads an aura.
Crystallize: earth hardens it into a shard; walk into it for a shield.
journal.elementalarcana.page.10:
§5§lEssence§r

Elemental creatures leave Essence behind. Infuse it into a spell, condense it into tree points, or bind eight with a diamond into a Catalyst, to reach for a new element.
journal.elementalarcana.page.11:
§5§lDanger§r

Creatures grow stronger the farther you go from where you began, the deeper you dig, and beyond the Nether's gate.

Attuned casters glow before they cast. When you see it: move!
journal.elementalarcana.element.fire:
§6§lYour magic: Fire§r

Fire strikes hard and what it touches burns. Melt frozen foes for heavy damage.

Your spells hit ice creatures hard; water creatures shrug them off.
journal.elementalarcana.element.water:
§9§lYour magic: Water§r

Water pushes, soaks and mends. Soaked foes freeze and vaporize easily.

Your spells hit fire and earth creatures hard. Ice is your kin: its part of the tree is open to you.
journal.elementalarcana.element.ice:
§b§lYour magic: Ice§r

Ice slows, freezes and controls. Soak a foe, then freeze it solid.

Your spells hit water creatures hard; fire ones shrug them off. Water is your kin: its part of the tree is open to you.
journal.elementalarcana.element.wind:
§a§lYour magic: Wind§r

Wind is quick and free. It throws foes into the air, where they take more damage, and Swirls any aura onto everything near.

Earth creatures are your bane.
journal.elementalarcana.element.earth:
§e§lYour magic: Earth§r

Earth holds the line. Boulders crush and shove, Stone Skin shrugs off blows, and Crystallize turns a foe's fire or frost into a shield for you.

Your spells hit wind creatures hard.
journal.elementalarcana.element.crystal:
§d§lYour magic: Crystal§r

Crystal is Earth made keen. Prism Bolts burst into shards, and their hits Crystallize like Earth's.

Wind and lightning creatures fear it. Earth is your kin: its tree is open to you.
journal.elementalarcana.element.lightnin:
§e§lYour magic: Lightning§r

Lightning leaps from foe to foe, and farther through anything wet.

Water creatures fear it; earth and crystal ground it. Wind is your kin: its tree is open to you.
journal.elementalarcana.element.radiance:
§6§lYour magic: Radiance§r

Radiance strikes from the sky, sets foes alight and burns the undead most.

Ice creatures fear it; water ones shrug it off. Fire is your kin: its tree is open to you.
journal.elementalarcana.lore.1:
§5§lThe Prime§r

Once, magic was one: the Prime. When the Hollow came, a hunger that devours mana, the first mages broke the Prime into the elements and bound the Hollow with them.
journal.elementalarcana.lore.2:
§5§lThe Seals§r

Four Sovereigns keep the seals, one for each element. The seals are fading. That is why mana stirs in people like you again, and why elemental things walk the world.
journal.elementalarcana.lore.3:
§5§lThe Road§r

Seek the places where an element runs strong. Learn from those who walked this path before you. Grow.

The Hollow is patient. You will need to be strong when it wakes.
message.elementalarcana.journal_given: A journal appears among your things: the Arcanist's Journal. Read it.
message.elementalarcana.shrine.discovere: You found a shrine of %s. (+%s XP)
message.elementalarcana.shrine.spent: The shrine has given what it can today. Return tomorrow.
message.elementalarcana.shrine.stirs: The shrine of %s hums, and something in you stirs, but does not wake. Return tomorrow.
message.elementalarcana.awakening.shrine: The shrine of %s answered you, and your magic woke.
message.elementalarcana.shrine.blessed: The shrine of %s blesses you: your mana is full, and its element runs strong in you.
journal.elementalarcana.page.12:
§5§lShrines§r

Shrines of the elements stand across the world. Near one, mana returns faster. Touch its core once a day: it blesses the awakened, and may wake the magic of one who still sleeps.
journal.elementalarcana.page.13:
§5§lWisps§r

Wisps are drops of pure element, drawn to mana. They guard the shrines and drift through their element's lands.

They leave the sleeping be, and their own kin. Any other mage they take for a rival. Each one holds Essence.
commands.elementalarcana.wisp_none: No wisp could come here (no open ground nearby, or a biome without wisps)
journal.elementalarcana.page.14:
§5§lArcanists§r

Some villagers study magic. Give one an Arcane Lectern (a lectern, an amethyst shard and two Essence) and they'll trade in Essence, wands, robes, even Catalysts.

Some villages already have an Arcanist's cottage.
item.elementalarcana.scroll_of_unbinding: Read it to give back every skill tree node you bought, for free
item.elementalarcana.tome_of_insight.des: Read it for one more skill tree point
message.elementalarcana.unbinding.nothin: There's nothing to unbind: you haven't taken any tree nodes
message.elementalarcana.unbinding.done: The scroll crumbles to dust, and your skill tree comes unbound: %s nodes given back.
message.elementalarcana.insight.dormant: The words mean nothing to you yet
message.elementalarcana.insight.done: The tome's insight settles in you: +1 tree point.
journal.elementalarcana.page.15:
§5§lMage towers§r

Far from where the world began stand towers of elemental stone. In each a Magister hoards a stolen piece of an element, served by acolytes.

Climb to the sanctum and defeat it: its Guardian Core is the key to master gear.
item.elementalarcana.guardian_core.desc: A Magister's stolen power, the key to master gear
message.elementalarcana.sanctum.restored: The seal of Flame holds again.
The seal of Tides holds again.
The seal of Storms holds again.
The seal of Stone holds again.
message.elementalarcana.sovereign.enrage: The ground shudders: Orvald will not yield!
item.elementalarcana.sovereign_heart.des: Taken from a fallen Sovereign. The key to archmage gear, and to the way to the Hollow.
item.elementalarcana.prime_key.desc: Four Sovereign hearts made one. Hold it to open the way to the Hollow, for you and everyone beside you.
message.elementalarcana.prime_key.wrong_: The key will only turn in the world above.
message.elementalarcana.hollow.rises: The Hollow rises from the maw.
message.elementalarcana.hollow.form.fire: The Hollow takes the shape of Flame!
message.elementalarcana.hollow.form.wate: The Hollow takes the shape of Tides!
message.elementalarcana.hollow.form.wind: The Hollow takes the shape of Storms!
message.elementalarcana.hollow.form.eart: The Hollow takes the shape of Stone!
message.elementalarcana.hollow.epilogue: Magic was one, then many. Now it answers you, and the hunger sleeps. For now.
message.elementalarcana.hollow.spat: The void won't have you. The Hollow spits you back out.
message.elementalarcana.aura.hidden: You draw your aura in. Creatures notice you less; your mana returns slowly.
message.elementalarcana.aura.shown: You let your aura out again.
message.elementalarcana.tide.rises: A mana tide rises. The air hums with power.
item.elementalarcana.prime_heart.desc: Use it: every element you don't hold yet awakens, and you gain 5 tree points.
message.elementalarcana.prime_heart.used: Your magic remembers that it was one.
death.attack.elementalarcana.hollow_hung: %1$s was devoured by the Hollow while fighting %2$s
message.elementalarcana.tower.magister: The Magister appears: "You climbed my tower. You won't climb down."
message.elementalarcana.tower.conquered: The Magister falls, and the tower's heart goes dark.
journal.elementalarcana.page.16:
§5§lBrews§r

From an Awkward Potion:
- amethyst: Mana Draught
- a Wisp Mote: Elixir of Clarity, faster mana
- lapis: Elixir of Focus
- prismarine crystals: Elixir of Warding

Glowstone makes them stronger, redstone longer.
journal.elementalarcana.page.17:
§5§lKindred Elements§r

Ice, Crystal, Lightning and Radiance are kin of Water, Earth, Wind and Fire.

With 10 Affinity in an element, its kin's part of the tree opens to you.

Lightning wisps ride the thunderstorms.
journal.elementalarcana.page.18:
§5§lSanctums§r

Far from where the world began, the Sovereigns sleep in sanctums: Flame in deserts, Tides on coasts, Storms on mountains, Stone in forests.

Master Arcanists sell maps to them.
journal.elementalarcana.page.19:
§5§lSovereigns§r

Come near a seal and its Sovereign wakes, the strongest thing you will face. Even kin are tested.

Its Heart makes archmage gear, and opens the way to the Hollow.
journal.elementalarcana.page.20:
§5§lThe Hollow§r

Four Sovereign hearts make the Prime Key. Turn it, and the way opens to where the hunger waits.

It wears the elements it ate: strike each shape with what beats it.
journal.elementalarcana.page.21:
§5§lAuras and Tides§r

With Insight you read a creature's aura: its level, then its element. Far stronger ones press on you. H hides your own.

Mana runs rich far out, thin in the deep dark. Sometimes a tide rises.
journal.elementalarcana.page.22:
§5§lRifts§r

The seals are thin: now and then, mostly at night, the world tears open near a mage, and a pillar of light marks it. Creatures of its element climb out, three waves of them.

Beat them all and the rift spills what it swallowed.
